newsitem.title: USA: CBOE says suspends trading in Centennial options.
newsitem.headline: CBOE says suspends trading in Centennial options.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Tuesday it suspended trading in options on Centennial Technologies Inc until further notice.
It said the suspension continued a trading halt in the options that took effect at the opening of trading Monday.
The New York Stock Exchange suspended the stock from Monday and has said it planned to delist it.

The CBOE said it would assess on an ongoing basis whether to permit trading to resume in Centennial options and if so, what type of trading restrictions, if any, should apply. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
